name: invest-like Halal Consensus 7 Index
description: Equal-weight, daily-rebalanced, price-return index of every US-listed stock that passes all 7 investor frameworks AND is AAOIFI Standard 21 compliant. The intersection of quality value investing and halal compliance. Monthly reconstitution.

rules.eligibility: bulls === 7 (all seven frameworks score the stock >= 60) AND AAOIFI Standard 21 compliant, with a positive quoted price
rules.weighting: equal weight, rebalanced daily (index return = arithmetic mean of constituent price returns)
rules.reconstitution: first computation of each UTC month swaps the basket to the current eligible cohort
